tweets.text: these are challenging times for micromanagers. remote presents some real hurdles.

"We've been doing OKRs for a year."

"Are they working?"

"What do you mean?"

"Do they help teams have more impact for customers?"

"I thought they were more for internal alignment. For accountability. Something we just do."

"So that you can..."

"Oh, I see...I'm not sure."

Lol

OH: “Developing yet another business application is not complex. This is not new ground. What is complex is dealing with 375 egos trying to make this more complex than it really is...”
